biography.plain_text: David McKenzie is an American television producer, director and president of Associated Television International. Over more than three decades, he has built a career spanning syndicated series, network specials, awards broadcasts and documentaries. His work includes repeated leadership of the Daytime Emmy telecast and long-running entertainment formats distributed across major US networks.

long_biography.plain_text:
The Daytime Emmy Awards became one of David McKenzie's most visible production assignments. Through Associated Television International, he served as executive producer and director for multiple telecasts, helping return the ceremony to national broadcast television. The role drew on decades of experience producing syndicated programs, network specials and documentary projects from Los Angeles.

McKenzie is president of Associated Television International, a production and distribution company whose programming spans broadcast, cable, syndication and international sales. His credits include long-running entertainment formats, family programming and nonfiction specials. His directing work has also received multiple Daytime Emmy Awards for documentary specials.

uncertainties.detail: David McKenzie has many namesakes. Resolution rests on the immutable film-producer and daughter-profile clue, Forbes's independent identification of the same ATI president and family collaborators, and separate NATAS, D&B and ATI company/geography anchors. No name-only match was accepted.

Reliable sources call McKenzie ATI's president and key principal and describe the business as his operating platform, but do not establish the company's founding capital, acquisition path, exact equity or any inherited advantage. Wealth origin is therefore Unknown and relationship is Operator rather than Founder.

No strong source established a full legal name, birth date, birthplace or birth country. Recent production credits support a continuing career but are not treated as sufficient evidence to overwrite the immutable Unknown mortality status.

ATI's facilities, programming library, distribution relationships and production output are company attributes. They are not presented as McKenzie's direct personal assets, and no personal net-worth estimate is used.
No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website cleared the verification threshold. The official ATI site is proposed only under the distinct Company Website type.

No current or former vessel fact appears in either biography. Private family detail beyond the identity anchor, legal and political matters, controversies, transient programming claims, unverified revenue figures and personal-asset speculation were excluded. Nothing was compiled or applied.
